title: Linux install has no OS containment and nothing says so — benchmark finding P4

AC1.note: report_sandbox_status() in install.sh names bubblewrap and the install command; tested with a PATH filtered of bwrap, plus a falsifiable counterpart with a fake bwrap shim. (PR #257)

AC2.note: sandboxCommand never touches process.exitCode; verified for missing-launcher and unsupported-platform. Smoke-run on this host printed the matrix and exited 0. (PR #257)

AC3.note: Named constants LAUNCHER_NOT_INSTALLED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED_ON_PLATFORM; test asserts both exist and are mutually exclusive per row. (PR #257)

AC4.note: capability-matrix.doc-sync.test.ts parses the runbook table live and diffs it against SANDBOX_CAPABILITY_MATRIX, with a flipped-row falsifiability check. (PR #257)

AC5.note: No edits to shell-exec-tool.ts, sandbox-config.ts or any fail-closed path; detect/adapter/shell-exec suites re-run unchanged. (PR #257)

AC6.note: Descriptor registered in command-registry.ts with 9 intent phrases; matchIntent resolves to 'sandbox status'. (PR #257)
